name: High-heat welding kit
description: An arc welder packed with a folded fireproof blanket that holds heat around the joint, so hardened and tempered steel can be welded without cracking.
notes: A blue welder case 300 by 220 by 220 mm with a dial, sockets and carry handle, standing on a folded flame-resistant blanket 500 by 360 mm, with the cable coiled beside it and the electrode holder and earth clamp in front. CHECK VOLUME (x4.67): the box counts the air around the welder on the wider blanket and the handle. cloth-turnout stands in for the reference's asbestos blanket. welding is a new quality name; 2 marks it above a plain welder because the reference's kit is for tempered steel. It needs electric power, which has no content field yet.

name: Wire drawing machine
description: A bench machine that pulls steel rod through a block of narrowing dies onto a cranked drum, thinning it into wire.
notes: A steel base 500 by 240 mm with a die block of six tapering holes at one end and a capstan drum 160 mm across with a top crank at the other, a length of wire running between them. The reference lists no qualities; wire_drawing is the name batch 063 gave a hand drawplate at 1, and this machine draws more and finer wire, so 2. At 26 kg it works where it stands, so it carries the quality as a workstation, not a hand tool.

name: Wooden float
description: A long pine board with a grip nailed on top, for spreading and smoothing wet concrete or mortar. Swung edge-on, it makes a clumsy club.
notes: A board 610 by 120 by 22 mm with a round oak grip on two blocks, 92 mm tall overall. Box volume x1.99 is the air under the grip. planing 1 is the hand end of the planing scale, which takes in smoothing wood and wet finishes. It is made by the player, never found, so it has no spawn tiers.

name: Giant pipe wrench
description: A pipe wrench as long as a man's leg, with a red iron handle and toothed jaws that open wide enough for water mains. Far too heavy to carry around for long.
notes: Lies flat: a red I-beam handle 1.2 m overall, a cast frame with a knurled adjusting nut, a toothed heel jaw and a hook jaw on a shank across the frame, opening 120 mm. CHECK VOLUME (x11.02): the reference's 1.9 L is under the iron in a 14 kg wrench, while the box counts the jaw opening and the shank standing out across the frame. The reference lists no qualities; wrenching 3 because it turns pipe and fittings no hand wrench can, though it is too large for nuts and bolts. A melee use as a heavy club has no content field here.

name: Large adjustable wrench
description: A long adjustable spanner whose jaws open past two inches, with enough leverage for wheel nuts and stuck bolts.
notes: Shares a local adjustable-spanner builder with the small wrench: a tapered handle with a hang hole, a round head, two jaws and a knurled worm, 460 mm long. Box volume x2.12 is the jaw opening and the head's width over the handle. wrenching 2 marks an adjustable or large wrench; the reference's quick wheel change folds into wrenching.

name: Small adjustable wrench
description: A palm-sized adjustable spanner for small nuts and bolts in tight spaces.
notes: The large wrench's builder at 150 mm. wrenching 1 marks a small wrench; the reference's fine bolt-turning quality folds into it.

name: Craft knife
description: A slim pen-shaped handle holding a tiny pointed blade, made for precise cuts in paper, cloth and thin plastic. It cuts deep but barely reaches.
notes: A ribbed 9 mm handle, a tapered collet and an angled pointed blade, 100 mm long; the blade is drawn 2 mm thick because 2 mm is the finest grain. cutting 2 marks a precision blade; the reference's fine and cloth-cutting qualities fold into it. butchering is held at 1, the low end, because the blade is too short to joint a carcass.

name: Fidget spinner
description: A three-lobed plastic toy that spins on a bearing between finger and thumb. It does nothing useful, which used to be the point.
notes: Lies flat: a blue three-lobed body about 95 mm across with a centre bearing under black caps and a steel weight ring in each lobe. Box volume x0.65 because the reference's 185 ml is its packaging, not the toy. A morale use has no content field yet.
